svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Apply to a job directly from where the update is received via a direct apply button in the
email or a quick apply button in the portal, instead of navigating to the app and then th
e company's portal → Complete a job application quickly

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
View and apply through the company's job portal in an in-page (integrated) view inside the
application instead of being navigated to another page → Have every job-related activity
available inside the job portal without navigating to another application or the company's
portal

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Save or bookmark interesting job postings inside the job portal to apply to them later → H
ave every job-related activity available inside the job portal without navigating to anoth
er application or the company's portal

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Receive job updates by professional email → Receive job updates for roles in the user's do

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式

ve only job postings relevant to the user's criteria, not a random or unrelated job list

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Have the job list derived automatically from the profile (roles, work done, experience, sk
ill sets, projects) so no additional filters need to be added → Receive only job postings

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Have a tool or plugin that matches the required skill set against the user's and gives a m
atch percentage → Receive only job postings relevant to the user's criteria, not a random
or unrelated job list

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Not have personal data exposed to people or platforms outside the job platform → Not be co
ntacted by random or irrelevant people or recruiters through the platform
